description: Zoho sync state of the order, stored under $app.zoho

zoho_status.description: synced: everything the order's state calls for exists in Zoho; pending: partly done, continues shortly; error: see zoho_error

zoho_salesorder_confirmed.description: The sales order was confirmed, so it reserves stock (Zoho creates it as a draft)

zoho_salesorder_voided.description: The sales order was voided in Zoho after the order was canceled unpaid

zoho_payment_unapplied.description: The payment was detached from the invoice so the invoice could be voided

zoho_invoice_voided.description: The invoice was voided after the order was canceled before shipping

zoho_retry_at.description: When the retry job tries a failed order again

zoho_continuations.description: Runs in a row that stopped at their time budget; order-continue stops chaining after a few

zoho_claimed_at.description: Set when the order.submitted handler starts; order.paid waits for it to finish

zoho_shipping_claimed_at.description: Set while a Zoho shipment update runs for this order; clears when it ends
